title: Debug symbols
summary: Debian's debug symbols for the box's own programs (nginx, Kiwix, mosquitto), so gdb's backtraces name functions and lines. Only for what is installed here; about 14 MB for all of them.
consent: These come from Debian's debug archive (debian-debug), signed with the same keys as the rest of Debian. They change nothing that runs; they only let a debugger read the programs.
notes: From Debian's debug archive, checked with Debian's own keys; its index is kept apart from the box's lists.
A program's symbols must match its version exactly: after an update of the program, fetch the kit again.
Use with the Debugging kit's gdb. Larger extras, on request: libicu76-dbgsym and libxapian30-dbgsym (25 MB, Kiwix's search), systemd-dbgsym (7 MB).
